entities.name: Honokiol
observations: Honokiol treatment inhibited melanoma cell growth and reduced melanoma spheroid number and size dose-dependently in a primary study (PMID:25450590).

entities.name: AMPK signaling
observations: Honokiol treatment was associated with increased AMPK phosphorylation in melanoma cells; the study interprets growth inhibition as mediated through AMPK signaling (PMID:25450590).

entities.name: Melanoma
observations: In vitro melanoma cell and cancer stem-cell models were tested for honokiol-induced growth and spheroid effects (PMID:25450590).

entities.name: PMID:25450590
observations: “Honokiol affects melanoma cell growth by targeting the AMP-activated protein kinase signaling pathway.” The study reports growth inhibition, reduced melanosphere formation, increased AMPK phosphorylation, and decreased cellular ATP.

entities.name: Honokiol AMPK melanoma
observations: A 2014 cell-based study reported honokiol-associated AMPK phosphorylation increase and dose-dependent loss of melanoma melanosphere number/size, interpreting inhibition as AMPK-mediated; evidence is preclinical (PMID:25450590).
